goal: Allow separate processes like wallets and indexers to access node chain state and notifications over IPC
agreement: Strong support for enabling out-of-process wallets and indexers (ariard, willcl-ark, Sjors, rustaceanrob)
Verified by testing with external Rust wallet and Electrs integrations (darosior, Sjors)
Approval from an account with no project history and no stated reason (Big621)
Unaddressed objection: node aborts if a notifications client returns an error, author replied (xyzconstant)

categories.name: ipc
why: P1 because it unblocks running the wallet in a separate process (#10102)
Foundational building block for downstream tools and out-of-process indexers to consume chain state via IPC
